text: (1) For the purposes of this Act, there is to be an office called the Trade Marks Office. (2) The Registrar may establish one or more sub-offices of the Trade Marks Office as the Registrar considers appropriate. (3) The Registrar may abolish any such sub-offices.
title: Trade Marks Office and sub-offices

units.text: (1) For the purposes of this Act, there is to be an office called the Trade Marks Office.
(2) The Registrar may establish one or more sub-offices of the Trade Marks Office as the Registrar considers appropriate.
(3) The Registrar may abolish any such sub-offices.
